answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 2-token bond and answers beacon challenges with proof of work; missed proofs flag the account. Honest agents bend like a willow under rare checks, while a forger running an ocean of fakes must heartbeat each. So 1,000 fakes cost 2,000 tokens per epoch versus 2 for one honest agent; a plume of flagged proofs triggers slashing, leaving honest rewards undiluted.
